value.description: The Hiwatt Hi-5 combo amplifier delivers classic Hiwatt tone in a compact, portable package. Featuring a 10-inch speaker and tube circuitry, it's perfect for practice, recording, or small gigs, offering a responsive and dynamic playing experience.
value.description_short: Classic Hiwatt tube tone in a compact 1x10 combo amp.
